<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>PayrollProof — multi-page mockup</title>
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Archivo:wght@500;600;700;800&family=Inter:wght@400;500;600&family=IBM+Plex+Mono:wght@400;500;600&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
  :root{
    --navy:#2B4C7E; --navy-deep:#1B3358; --orange:#E8732A; --orange-soft:#F4A968;
    --ink:#14233B; --slate:#516079; --paper:#F7F8FA; --line:#DCE2EC; --white:#FFFFFF;
    --blueprint:rgba(255,255,255,.12);
  }
  *{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0;}
  html{scroll-behavior:smooth;}
  body{font-family:'Inter',system-ui,sans-serif;color:var(--ink);background:var(--white);line-height:1.6;-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;}
  h1,h2,h3,h4{font-family:'Archivo',sans-serif;line-height:1.1;letter-spacing:-.01em;}
  .eyebrow{font-family:'IBM Plex Mono',monospace;font-size:.72rem;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:.18em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--orange);display:inline-block;}
  .wrap{max-width:1140px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 28px;}
  a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none;}
  .btn{font-family:'Archivo',sans-serif;font-weight:600;font-size:.95rem;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:.5em;padding:14px 24px;border-radius:6px;cursor:pointer;border:2px solid transparent;transition:transform .15s ease,background .15s ease,border-color .15s ease;}
  .btn:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);}
  .btn-orange{background:var(--orange);color:#fff;} .btn-orange:hover{background:#d56516;}
  .btn-ghost{background:transparent;color:#fff;border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.45);} .btn-ghost:hover{border-color:#fff;}
  .btn-navy{background:var(--navy);color:#fff;} .btn-navy:hover{background:var(--navy-deep);}
  .btn-outline{background:transparent;color:var(--navy);border-color:var(--line);} .btn-outline:hover{border-color:var(--navy);}
  .page{display:none;}

  /* NAV */
  nav{position:sticky;top:0;z-index:50;background:rgba(27,51,88,.96);backdrop-filter:blur(8px);border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08);}
  .nav-in{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;height:68px;gap:18px;}
  .brand{display:flex;align-items:center;cursor:pointer;background:#fff;padding:6px 12px;border-radius:8px;box-shadow:0 4px 14px -6px rgba(0,0,0,.3);}
  .brand img{height:32px;width:auto;display:block;}
  .nav-links{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:24px;}
  .nav-links a{color:rgba(255,255,255,.8);font-size:.92rem;font-weight:500;cursor:pointer;}
  .nav-links a:hover,.nav-links a.active{color:#fff;}
  .nav-links a.active{border-bottom:2px solid var(--orange);padding-bottom:3px;}
  .nav-cta{display:flex;gap:12px;align-items:center;}
  .nav-cta .btn{padding:10px 18px;font-size:.86rem;}
  .nav-toggle{display:none;background:none;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.25);border-radius:6px;color:#fff;font-size:1.3rem;cursor:pointer;padding:6px 12px;line-height:1;}
  /* mobile drawer */
  .mobile-drawer{display:none;background:var(--navy-deep);border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08);padding:14px 0;}
  .mobile-drawer.open{display:block;}
  .mobile-drawer a{display:block;color:rgba(255,255,255,.86);font-size:1rem;font-weight:500;padding:12px 28px;cursor:pointer;border-left:3px solid transparent;}
  .mobile-drawer a:hover,.mobile-drawer a.active{background:rgba(255,255,255,.04);border-left-color:var(--orange);color:#fff;}
  .mobile-drawer .mctas{display:flex;gap:10px;padding:14px 28px 4px;flex-wrap:wrap;}
  .mobile-drawer .mctas .btn{flex:1;justify-content:center;min-width:140px;padding:11px 14px;font-size:.86rem;}

  /* HOME HERO */
  header.hero{background:radial-gradient(1200px 500px at 80% -10%,rgba(232,115,42,.16),transparent 60%),linear-gradient(180deg,var(--navy-deep) 0%,var(--navy) 100%);color:#fff;position:relative;overflow:hidden;}
  header.hero:before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background-image:linear-gradient(var(--blueprint) 1px,transparent 1px),linear-gradient(90deg,var(--blueprint) 1px,transparent 1px);background-size:46px 46px;opacity:.5;mask-image:linear-gradient(180deg,transparent,#000 30%,#000 70%,transparent);}
  .hero-in{position:relative;padding:72px 0 80px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.15fr .85fr;gap:48px;align-items:center;}
  .hero-text h1{font-size:clamp(2.1rem,4.6vw,3.5rem);font-weight:800;max-width:15ch;margin:18px 0 0;}
  .hero-text h1 em{font-style:normal;color:var(--orange-soft);}
  .hero-text p.lead{font-size:1.1rem;color:rgba(255,255,255,.84);max-width:58ch;margin:22px 0 0;}
  .cred-badge{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;margin-top:26px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.06);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.16);padding:12px 18px;border-radius:8px;font-size:.9rem;color:rgba(255,255,255,.92);}
  .cred-badge .seal{width:34px;height:34px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--orange);display:grid;place-items:center;font-family:'Archivo';font-weight:800;font-size:.78rem;color:#fff;flex-shrink:0;}
  .hero-cta{display:flex;gap:12px;margin-top:28px;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;}
  .hero-cta .txtlink{color:rgba(255,255,255,.8);font-size:.92rem;font-weight:500;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.35);padding-bottom:2px;cursor:pointer;}
  .hero-cta .txtlink:hover{color:#fff;}
  .hero-stats{display:flex;gap:38px;margin-top:42px;flex-wrap:wrap;}
  .hero-stats .stat .n{font-family:'Archivo';font-weight:800;font-size:1.7rem;color:#fff;}
  .hero-stats .stat .l{font-size:.8rem;color:rgba(255,255,255,.62);max-width:22ch;}
  .hero-visual{position:relative;}
  .hero-visual img{width:100%;height:auto;border-radius:14px;display:block;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.14);box-shadow:0 30px 70px -25px rgba(0,0,0,.6);}
  .hero-visual:after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:-8px -8px auto auto;width:60%;height:60%;border-top:2px solid var(--orange);border-right:2px solid var(--orange);border-radius:0 14px 0 0;opacity:.55;pointer-events:none;}
  .hero-tag{position:absolute;bottom:14px;left:14px;right:14px;background:rgba(20,35,59,.86);backdrop-filter:blur(4px);border-radius:10px;padding:10px 14px;font-family:'IBM Plex Mono';font-size:.74rem;letter-spacing:.06em;color:rgba(255,255,255,.86);display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;}
  .hero-tag .dot{width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--orange);box-shadow:0 0 0 4px rgba(232,115,42,.25);flex-shrink:0;}

  /* SUBPAGE HERO */
  .page-hero{background:linear-gradient(180deg,var(--navy-deep),var(--navy));color:#fff;position:relative;overflow:hidden;}
  .page-hero:before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background-image:linear-gradient(var(--blueprint) 1px,transparent 1px),linear-gradient(90deg,var(--blueprint) 1px,transparent 1px);background-size:46px 46px;opacity:.4;mask-image:linear-gradient(180deg,transparent,#000 40%,#000 70%,transparent);}
  .page-hero-in{position:relative;padding:64px 0 60px;}
  .page-hero h1{font-size:clamp(2rem,4.4vw,3.1rem);font-weight:800;max-width:18ch;margin-top:12px;}
  .page-hero p{color:rgba(255,255,255,.82);font-size:1.1rem;max-width:60ch;margin-top:16px;}

  section{padding:80px 0;}
  .sec-head{text-align:center;max-width:64ch;margin:0 auto 46px;}
  .sec-head h2{font-size:clamp(1.8rem,3.4vw,2.5rem);font-weight:700;color:var(--ink);margin-top:12px;}
  .sec-head p{color:var(--slate);font-size:1.06rem;margin-top:14px;}

  /* THREE OFFERINGS (home) */
  .fork{background:var(--paper);}
  .three{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:24px;}
  .path{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:14px;padding:32px 28px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;position:relative;overflow:hidden;}
  .path:before{content:"";position:absolute;top:0;left:0;right:0;height:5px;}
  .path.gc:before{background:var(--navy);} .path.intensive:before{background:var(--orange);} .path.sub:before{background:var(--orange-soft);}
  .path .who{font-family:'IBM Plex Mono';font-size:.72rem;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--slate);}
  .path h3{font-size:1.42rem;font-weight:700;margin:8px 0 4px;color:var(--ink);}
  .path .tag{font-family:'IBM Plex Mono';font-size:.78rem;font-weight:500;}
  .path.gc .tag{color:var(--navy);} .path.intensive .tag{color:var(--orange);} .path.sub .tag{color:#c5752f;}
  .path .pitch{font-size:1rem;color:var(--ink);margin:16px 0 18px;font-weight:500;}
  .path ul{list-style:none;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px;margin-bottom:22px;}
  .path li{display:flex;gap:10px;font-size:.92rem;color:var(--slate);}
  .path li svg{flex-shrink:0;margin-top:4px;}
  .path .from{font-family:'IBM Plex Mono';font-size:.84rem;color:var(--ink);margin-bottom:16px;}
  .path .from b{font-size:1.05rem;color:var(--navy);}
  .path .btn{margin-top:auto;align-self:flex-start;}

  /* SOFTWARE (home) */
  .sw{background:#fff;}
  .steps{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:20px;margin-bottom:18px;}
  .step{background:var(--paper);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:12px;padding:24px;}
  .step .num{font-family:'IBM Plex Mono';font-weight:600;color:var(--orange);font-size:.9rem;}
  .step h4{font-size:1.05rem;margin:10px 0 6px;color:var(--ink);}
  .step p{font-size:.9rem;color:var(--slate);}
  .privacy{display:flex;gap:14px;align-items:flex-start;background:var(--paper);border:1px solid var(--line);border-left:5px solid var(--navy);border-radius:10px;padding:18px 22px;margin:30px 0 50px;font-size:.96rem;color:var(--slate);}
  .privacy strong{color:var(--ink);}
  .tiers{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:22px;}
  .tier{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:14px;padding:30px 26px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;}
  .tier.feat{border:2px solid var(--orange);box-shadow:0 18px 40px -22px rgba(232,115,42,.5);position:relative;}
  .tier.feat .ribbon{position:absolute;top:-12px;left:26px;background:var(--orange);color:#fff;font-family:'IBM Plex Mono';font-size:.66rem;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;padding:4px 12px;border-radius:20px;}
  .tier .tname{font-family:'IBM Plex Mono';font-size:.78rem;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--slate);}
  .tier .tprice{font-family:'Archivo';font-weight:800;font-size:2.3rem;color:var(--ink);margin:8px 0 2px;}
  .tier .tprice span{font-size:1rem;font-weight:500;color:var(--slate);}
  .tier .tgen{font-size:.92rem;color:var(--navy);font-weight:600;margin-bottom:18px;}
  .tier ul{list-style:none;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px;margin-bottom:24px;}
  .tier li{font-size:.92rem;color:var(--slate);display:flex;gap:9px;}
  .tier li svg{flex-shrink:0;margin-top:4px;}
  .tier .btn{margin-top:auto;width:100%;justify-content:center;}

  /* FOUNDER TEASER (home) */
  .f-teaser{background:var(--navy-deep);color:#fff;}
  .f-teaser-in{display:grid;grid-template-columns:160px 1fr auto;gap:32px;align-items:center;}
  .f-mini{width:160px;height:160px;border-radius:14px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--navy),var(--navy-deep));border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.16);overflow:hidden;}
  .f-mini img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;display:block;}
  .f-teaser .eyebrow{color:var(--orange-soft);}
  .f-teaser h3{font-size:1.7rem;font-weight:800;margin:8px 0 2px;}
  .f-teaser .creds{font-family:'IBM Plex Mono';font-size:.85rem;color:rgba(255,255,255,.7);}
  .f-teaser p{color:rgba(255,255,255,.84);max-width:52ch;margin-top:10px;font-size:.98rem;}

  /* MANAGED SERVICES page */
  .ms{background:#fff;}
  .ms-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.05fr .95fr;gap:56px;align-items:start;}
  .liability{background:var(--navy-deep);color:#fff;border-radius:12px;padding:24px 26px;margin:0 0 30px;font-size:.98rem;border-left:5px solid var(--orange);}
  .liability strong{color:var(--orange-soft);}
  .incl{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:14px 22px;margin-top:8px;}
  .incl div{display:flex;gap:10px;font-size:.95rem;color:var(--slate);}
  .incl svg{flex-shrink:0;margin-top:4px;}
  .anchorcard{background:var(--paper);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:14px;padding:32px;text-align:center;position:sticky;top:92px;}
  .anchorcard .ac-eyebrow{font-family:'IBM Plex Mono';font-size:.72rem;letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--orange);}
  .anchorcard .ac-from{font-family:'IBM Plex Mono';font-size:.74rem;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--slate);margin-top:12px;}
  .anchorcard .ac-price{font-family:'Archivo';font-weight:800;font-size:3rem;color:var(--ink);margin:4px 0 0;line-height:1;}
  .anchorcard .ac-price small{font-size:1rem;font-weight:500;color:var(--slate);}
  .anchorcard .ac-desc{font-size:.95rem;color:var(--slate);margin:18px 0 4px;}
  .anchorcard .ac-terms{font-family:'IBM Plex Mono';font-size:.78rem;color:var(--slate);margin-top:14px;line-height:1.7;}
  .anchorcard .btn{margin-top:22px;width:100%;justify-content:center;}

  /* INTENSIVE page */
  .preferred{max-width:880px;margin:0 auto 0;background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--navy-deep),var(--navy));color:#fff;border-radius:14px;padding:26px 30px;display:flex;gap:18px;align-items:center;border-left:6px solid var(--orange);}
  .preferred svg{flex-shrink:0;}
  .preferred b{color:var(--orange-soft);}
  .preferred p{font-size:1.04rem;margin:0;color:rgba(255,255,255,.92);}
  .value-head{text-align:center;margin:58px 0 22px;}
  .value-head h3{font-size:1.5rem;color:var(--ink);margin-top:8px;}
  .values{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:18px;}
  .vcard{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:14px;padding:26px 22px;}
  .vcard .vi{width:42px;height:42px;border-radius:10px;background:rgba(232,115,42,.12);display:grid;place-items:center;margin-bottom:14px;}
  .vcard h4{font-size:1.06rem;color:var(--ink);margin-bottom:6px;}
  .vcard p{font-size:.92rem;color:var(--slate);}
  .mech-head{text-align:center;margin:64px 0 22px;}
  .mech-head .eyebrow{color:var(--navy);}
  .mech-head h3{font-size:1.5rem;color:var(--ink);margin-top:8px;}
  .timeline{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:20px;}
  .week{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:12px;padding:24px;position:relative;}
  .week:before{content:"";position:absolute;top:0;left:0;right:0;height:4px;background:var(--orange);border-radius:12px 12px 0 0;opacity:.28;}
  .week .wk{font-family:'IBM Plex Mono';font-weight:600;color:var(--orange);font-size:.82rem;letter-spacing:.06em;}
  .week h4{font-size:1.02rem;margin:8px 0 6px;color:var(--ink);}
  .week p{font-size:.88rem;color:var(--slate);}
  .deliver-wrap{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.15fr .85fr;gap:40px;margin-top:42px;align-items:start;}
  .deliver h3{font-size:1.3rem;color:var(--ink);margin-bottom:16px;}
  .deliver ul{list-style:none;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:13px 24px;}
  .deliver li{display:flex;gap:10px;font-size:.95rem;color:var(--slate);}
  .deliver li b{color:var(--ink);font-weight:600;}
  .deliver svg{flex-shrink:0;margin-top:4px;}
  .price{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:16px;padding:32px 30px;text-align:center;border-top:6px solid var(--orange);box-shadow:0 22px 50px -28px rgba(232,115,42,.5);}
  .price .p-eyebrow{font-family:'IBM Plex Mono';font-size:.72rem;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--orange);}
  .price .p-amt{font-family:'Archivo';font-weight:800;font-size:3.6rem;color:var(--ink);line-height:1;margin:12px 0 2px;}
  .price .p-flat{font-family:'IBM Plex Mono';font-size:.78rem;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--slate);}
  .price .p-allin{font-size:.96rem;color:var(--slate);margin:16px 0 0;}
  .price .p-incl{font-size:.9rem;color:var(--navy);font-weight:600;margin-top:14px;background:var(--paper);border-radius:8px;padding:13px;line-height:1.5;}
  .price .p-pay{font-size:.82rem;color:var(--slate);margin-top:12px;font-style:italic;}
  .price .btn{margin-top:18px;width:100%;justify-content:center;}
  .price .p-frac{font-family:'IBM Plex Mono';font-size:.74rem;color:var(--slate);margin-top:14px;border-top:1px dashed var(--line);padding-top:12px;}

  /* FOUNDER page */
  .founder-page{background:#fff;}
  .fp-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:220px 1fr;gap:54px;align-items:start;}
  .fp-photo{width:220px;height:220px;border-radius:16px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--navy),var(--navy-deep));border:1px solid var(--line);overflow:hidden;position:sticky;top:92px;}
  .fp-photo img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;display:block;}
  .fp-body .role{font-style:italic;color:var(--orange);margin:6px 0 22px;font-size:1.05rem;}
  .fp-body h3{font-size:1.2rem;color:var(--ink);margin:28px 0 10px;}
  .fp-body p{color:var(--slate);margin-bottom:14px;max-width:64ch;}
  .fp-creds{display:flex;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin:14px 0 0;}
  .fp-creds span{font-family:'IBM Plex Mono';font-size:.78rem;background:var(--paper);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:20px;padding:6px 14px;color:var(--navy);}
  .fp-contact{margin-top:28px;background:var(--paper);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:12px;padding:20px 24px;font-family:'IBM Plex Mono';font-size:.9rem;color:var(--slate);}
  .fp-contact a{color:var(--orange);}

  /* CONTACT + crosslink band */
  .contact{background:var(--paper);text-align:center;}
  .contact h2{font-size:clamp(1.8rem,3.6vw,2.6rem);font-weight:700;max-width:18ch;margin:14px auto 0;color:var(--ink);}
  .contact p{color:var(--slate);max-width:56ch;margin:16px auto 30px;font-size:1.06rem;}
  .contact .btns{display:flex;gap:14px;justify-content:center;flex-wrap:wrap;}

  /* FOOTER */
  footer{background:var(--navy-deep);color:rgba(255,255,255,.7);padding:48px 0 36px;border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08);}
  .foot-grid{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:30px;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:flex-start;}
  footer .brand{margin-bottom:12px;}
  footer .fnote{font-size:.86rem;max-width:36ch;}
  footer .fcols{display:flex;gap:54px;flex-wrap:wrap;}
  footer h5{font-family:'IBM Plex Mono';font-size:.72rem;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:rgba(255,255,255,.5);margin-bottom:12px;}
  footer .fcols a{display:block;font-size:.9rem;color:rgba(255,255,255,.75);margin-bottom:8px;cursor:pointer;} footer .fcols a:hover{color:#fff;}
  .foot-base{margin-top:36px;padding-top:22px;border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08);font-size:.8rem;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:14px;flex-wrap:wrap;}

  @media(max-width:1040px){
    .hero-in{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:36px;padding:60px 0 70px;}
    .hero-visual{order:2;max-width:560px;}
  }
  @media(max-width:980px){
    .three,.values,.timeline{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;}
    .ms-grid,.deliver-wrap,.fp-grid,.f-teaser-in{grid-template-columns:1fr;}
    .steps{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;}
    .anchorcard,.fp-photo{position:static;}
    .fp-photo{width:100%;max-width:220px;height:auto;aspect-ratio:1/1;margin:0 auto;}
    .f-teaser-in{text-align:center;justify-items:center;}
    .f-mini{margin:0 auto;}
  }
  @media(max-width:900px){
    .nav-links{display:none;}
    .nav-toggle{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;}
    .nav-cta .btn-ghost{display:none;}
    .nav-cta .btn{padding:8px 14px;font-size:.82rem;}
    .brand img{height:28px;}
  }
  @media(max-width:680px){
    .hero-cta{flex-direction:column;align-items:stretch;width:100%;}
    .hero-cta .btn{width:100%;justify-content:center;}
    .hero-cta .txtlink{align-self:center;margin-top:6px;}
    .hero-stats{gap:24px;}
    .hero-stats .stat{flex:1 1 140px;}
    .hero-tag{position:static;margin-top:10px;}
    .page-hero-in{padding:48px 0 44px;}
    .page-hero h1{font-size:1.85rem;}
  }
  @media(max-width:600px){
    .three,.values,.timeline,.steps,.tiers,.incl,.deliver ul{grid-template-columns:1fr;}
    .preferred{flex-direction:column;text-align:center;}
    section{padding:54px 0;}
    .sec-head h2{font-size:1.55rem;}
    .hero-stats .stat .n{font-size:1.4rem;}
    .price .p-amt{font-size:2.8rem;}
    .anchorcard .ac-price{font-size:2.4rem;}
    .nav-cta .btn{padding:7px 12px;font-size:.78rem;}
    .wrap{padding:0 20px;}
  }
  @media(max-width:380px){
    .nav-cta{display:none;}
  }
  /* MODAL */
  .modal-overlay{position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(20,35,59,.62);backdrop-filter:blur(3px);display:none;align-items:flex-start;justify-content:center;z-index:100;padding:40px 20px;overflow-y:auto;}
  .modal-overlay.open{display:flex;}
  .modal{background:#fff;border-radius:16px;max-width:540px;width:100%;position:relative;box-shadow:0 30px 80px -20px rgba(0,0,0,.45);overflow:hidden;animation:modalIn .22s ease;}
  @keyframes modalIn{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(14px);}to{opacity:1;transform:none;}}
  .modal:before{content:"";display:block;height:5px;background:var(--orange);}
  .modal-x{position:absolute;top:14px;right:18px;background:none;border:none;font-size:1.6rem;line-height:1;color:var(--slate);cursor:pointer;z-index:2;}
  .modal-x:hover{color:var(--ink);}
  .modal-body{padding:28px 34px 34px;}
  .modal-eyebrow{font-family:'IBM Plex Mono';font-size:.7rem;letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--orange);}
  .modal h3{font-size:1.5rem;color:var(--ink);margin:8px 0 6px;}
  .modal .modal-sub{font-size:.95rem;color:var(--slate);margin-bottom:22px;}
  .field{margin-bottom:14px;}
  .field label{display:block;font-family:'IBM Plex Mono';font-size:.72rem;letter-spacing:.05em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--slate);margin-bottom:6px;}
  .field label .req{color:var(--orange);}
  .field input,.field textarea{width:100%;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:8px;padding:11px 13px;font-family:'Inter';font-size:.95rem;color:var(--ink);background:#fff;transition:border-color .15s ease,box-shadow .15s ease;}
  .field input:focus,.field textarea:focus{outline:none;border-color:var(--orange);box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(232,115,42,.12);}
  .field textarea{resize:vertical;min-height:74px;}
  .field.invalid input,.field.invalid textarea{border-color:#c0392b;background:#fdf3f2;}
  .field .err{display:none;color:#c0392b;font-size:.78rem;margin-top:5px;}
  .field.invalid .err{display:block;}
  .row2{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:14px;}
  .modal-submit{width:100%;justify-content:center;margin-top:6px;}
  .modal-or{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;margin:18px 0;color:var(--slate);font-size:.82rem;}
  .modal-or:before,.modal-or:after{content:"";flex:1;height:1px;background:var(--line);}
  .modal-cal{width:100%;justify-content:center;}
  .modal-success{display:none;text-align:center;padding:10px 0 4px;}
  .modal-success .s-check{width:64px;height:64px;border-radius:50%;background:rgba(232,115,42,.12);display:grid;place-items:center;margin:0 auto 18px;}
  .modal-success h3{font-size:1.6rem;}
  .modal-success p{color:var(--slate);font-size:1rem;margin:6px auto 22px;max-width:42ch;}
  .modal-success .btn{width:100%;justify-content:center;margin-bottom:10px;}
  @media(max-width:480px){.row2{grid-template-columns:1fr;} .modal-body{padding:26px 22px 28px;}}
</style>
</head>

      <div class="timeline">

            <li><svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="none"><path d="M3 8.5l3 3 7-7" stroke="#E8732A" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/></svg>Fringe benefit calculations documented</li>
            <li><svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="none"><path d="M3 8.5l3 3 7-7" stroke="#E8732A" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/></svg>3–4 certified payrolls prepared &amp; submitted with you</li>
            <li><svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="none"><path d="M3 8.5l3 3 7-7" stroke="#E8732A" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/></svg><b>Coordination with your GC / prime</b> as needed</li>
            <li><svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="none"><path d="M3 8.5l3 3 7-7" stroke="#E8732A" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/></svg>A written go-forward compliance playbook</li>
            <li><svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="none"><path d="M3 8.5l3 3 7-7" stroke="#E8732A" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/></svg>30 days of post-engagement support</li>
            <li><svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="none"><path d="M3 8.5l3 3 7-7" stroke="#E8732A" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/></svg><b>6 months of PayrollProof software</b> included</li>

<!-- ================= FOUNDER ================= -->
<div class="page" id="page-founder">
  <div class="page-hero">
    <div class="wrap page-hero-in">
      <span class="eyebrow">Founder</span>
      <h1>Darcie Gregoire</h1>
      <p>The person who enforced Davis-Bacon for the federal government — now in your corner.</p>
    </div>
  </div>
  <section class="founder-page">
    <div class="wrap">
      <div class="fp-grid">
        <div class="fp-photo"><img id="founderFull" alt="Darcie Gregoire, founder of PayrollProof"></div>
        <div class="fp-body">
          <div class="role">Former U.S. Department of Labor Wage &amp; Hour Investigator</div>
          <p>Darcie spent her career inside the systems that govern federal construction. As a DOL Wage and Hour Investigator, she enforced the Davis-Bacon Act — auditing certified payrolls, calculating back wages, and seeing firsthand where contractors got tripped up. She then moved inside the industry as an HR director at a construction company, and went on to consult for contractors navigating the very complexity she once enforced.</p>
          <p>That combination is rare: she knows how the agency thinks, how a job site actually runs, and where the two collide. It's the reason her clients don't just survive an audit — they stop fearing one.</p>

          <div class="fp-creds">
            <span>SPHR</span><span>SHRM-SCP</span><span>Former U.S. DOL WHD Investigator</span><span>Charlotte, NC</span>
          </div>

          <h3>Why she built PayrollProof</h3>
          <p>Across consulting engagements, Darcie kept meeting the same two contractors: the one too intimidated by Davis-Bacon to bid federal work at all, and the one who won and was quietly panicking. The expertise to help them existed — it just wasn't reachable or affordable for a small contractor.</p>
          <p>PayrollProof is her answer. It puts that expertise in reach at every level: full-service compliance administration for the general contractors who carry the liability, a focused setup intensive for subs who just won their first federal bid, and self-service software for everyone who simply needs a clean WH-347 each week.</p>

          <h3>The practice today</h3>
          <p>PayrollProof is a specialized Davis-Bacon prevailing-wage practice and a BlueClaw company, serving general contractors and subcontractors on federally funded construction across the country from its home base in Charlotte.</p>

          <div class="fp-contact">
            Charlotte, NC · (704) 312-0385 · <a href="mailto:darcie@blueclaw.tech">darcie@blueclaw.tech</a>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </section>

<!-- REQUEST A PROPOSAL MODAL -->
<div class="modal-overlay" id="proposalModal">
  <div class="modal" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-labelledby="modalTitle">
    <button class="modal-x" data-close aria-label="Close">&times;</button>
    <div class="modal-body">
      <!-- Step 1: form -->
      <div id="modalStep1">
        <span class="modal-eyebrow" id="modalEyebrow">Managed Services · For General Contractors</span>
        <h3 id="modalTitle">Request a proposal</h3>
        <p class="modal-sub" id="modalSub">Tell us a little about your projects and we'll put together a tailored managed-services quote. Prefer to talk it through first? Book a call below.</p>
        <form id="proposalForm" novalidate>
          <input type="hidden" name="inquiry_type" id="inquiryType" value="Managed Services">
          <div class="row2">
            <div class="field"><label>First name <span class="req">*</span></label><input name="first" autocomplete="given-name"><div class="err">Please enter your first name.</div></div>
            <div class="field"><label>Last name <span class="req">*</span></label><input name="last" autocomplete="family-name"><div class="err">Please enter your last name.</div></div>
          </div>
          <div class="field"><label>Email <span class="req">*</span></label><input name="email" type="email" autocomplete="email"><div class="err">Please enter a valid email address.</div></div>
          <div class="field"><label>Phone <span class="req">*</span></label><input name="phone" type="tel" autocomplete="tel"><div class="err">Please enter your phone number.</div></div>
          <div class="field"><label>Company name <span class="req">*</span></label><input name="company" autocomplete="organization"><div class="err">Please enter your company name.</div></div>
          <div class="row2">
            <div class="field"><label>Project county</label><input name="county"></div>
            <div class="field"><label>State</label><input name="state"></div>
          </div>
          <div class="field"><label>Any additional information</label><textarea name="notes" placeholder="Number of active projects, subs, the portals you use, your timeline&hellip;"></textarea></div>
          <button type="submit" class="btn btn-orange modal-submit" id="modalSubmit">Request my proposal</button>
        </form>
        <div class="modal-or"><span>or</span></div>
        <a href="https://calendly.com/darcie-orderandoperations/30min" target="_blank" rel="noopener" class="btn btn-outline modal-cal">Book a meeting on my calendar &rarr;</a>
      </div>
      <!-- Step 2: success -->
      <div class="modal-success" id="modalStep2">
        <div class="s-check"><svg width="30" height="30" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none"><path d="M5 12.5l4 4 10-10" stroke="#E8732A" stroke-width="2.4" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/></svg></div>
        <h3>Ready to talk?</h3>
        <p>Thanks &mdash; your request is in, and I'll review your projects before we meet. The fastest next step is to grab a time on my calendar.</p>
        <a href="https://calendly.com/darcie-orderandoperations/30min" target="_blank" rel="noopener" class="btn btn-orange">Book a 30-minute call &rarr;</a>
        <button class="btn btn-outline" data-close>Done</button>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

<script>
(function(){
  var LOGO_SRC='data:image/jpeg;base64,';
  var HEADSHOT_SRC='data:image/jpeg;base64,';
  var TEAM_SRC='data:image/jpeg;base64,';
  // Assign embedded images
  var imgMap={navLogo:LOGO_SRC,footLogo:LOGO_SRC,heroPhoto:TEAM_SRC,founderMini:HEADSHOT_SRC,founderFull:HEADSHOT_SRC};
  for(var id in imgMap){var n=document.getElementById(id); if(n){n.src=imgMap[id];}}

  // Mobile drawer toggle
  var navToggle=document.getElementById('navToggle');
  var drawer=document.getElementById('mobileDrawer');
  function closeDrawer(){if(drawer){drawer.classList.remove('open');} if(navToggle){navToggle.setAttribute('aria-expanded','false');}}
  if(navToggle){
    navToggle.addEventListener('click', function(){
      var open=drawer.classList.toggle('open');
      navToggle.setAttribute('aria-expanded', open?'true':'false');
    });
  }

  function show(page){
    var pages=document.querySelectorAll('.page');
    for(var i=0;i<pages.length;i++){pages[i].style.display='none';}
    var el=document.getElementById('page-'+page);
    if(el){el.style.display='block';}
    var links=document.querySelectorAll('.nav-links a[data-nav]');
    for(var j=0;j<links.length;j++){
      links[j].classList.toggle('active', links[j].getAttribute('data-nav')===page);
    }
  }
  var overlay=document.getElementById('proposalModal');
  var step1=document.getElementById('modalStep1');
  var step2=document.getElementById('modalStep2');
  var form=document.getElementById('proposalForm');

  // ---- EMAIL DELIVERY ----
  // To make the form email darcie@blueclaw.tech on the LIVE site, set FORM_ENDPOINT
  // to your form-service URL. Web3Forms: 'https://api.web3forms.com/submit' (add your
  // access_key as a hidden field). Formspree: 'https://formspree.io/f/XXXXXXX'.
  // Left blank in this mockup, so submitting just advances to the confirmation screen.
  var FORM_ENDPOINT='';

  var MODAL_COPY={
    managed:{
      eyebrow:'Managed Services · For General Contractors',
      title:'Request a proposal',
      sub:"Tell us a little about your projects and we'll put together a tailored managed-services quote. Prefer to talk it through first? Book a call below.",
      submit:'Request my proposal',
      type:'Managed Services'
    },
    intensive:{
      eyebrow:'Bid Win Intensive · For Subcontractors',
      title:'Start your Bid Win Intensive',
      sub:"Just won a federal bid? Share a few details and we'll get your Intensive scheduled. Prefer to talk it through first? Book a call below.",
      submit:'Request my Intensive',
      type:'Bid Win Intensive'
    }
  };

  function openModal(which){
    var c=MODAL_COPY[which]||MODAL_COPY.managed;
    document.getElementById('modalEyebrow').textContent=c.eyebrow;
    document.getElementById('modalTitle').textContent=c.title;
    document.getElementById('modalSub').textContent=c.sub;
    document.getElementById('modalSubmit').textContent=c.submit;
    document.getElementById('inquiryType').value=c.type;
    step1.style.display='block'; step2.style.display='none';
    overlay.classList.add('open');
    var f=form.querySelector('input[name="first"]'); if(f){setTimeout(function(){f.focus();},60);}
  }
  function closeModal(){
    overlay.classList.remove('open');
    step1.style.display='block'; step2.style.display='none';
  }
  function clearErrors(){
    var fl=form.querySelectorAll('.field.invalid');
    for(var i=0;i<fl.length;i++){fl[i].classList.remove('invalid');}
  }
  function validate(){
    clearErrors();
    var ok=true;
    var req=['first','last','email','phone','company'];
    for(var i=0;i<req.length;i++){
      var inp=form.querySelector('[name="'+req[i]+'"]');
      if(!inp.value.trim()){inp.closest('.field').classList.add('invalid');ok=false;}
    }
    var email=form.querySelector('[name="email"]');
    if(email.value.trim() && !/^[^@\s]+@[^@\s]+\.[^@\s]+$/.test(email.value.trim())){email.closest('.field').classList.add('invalid');ok=false;}
    return ok;
  }
  function goSuccess(){ step1.style.display='none'; step2.style.display='block'; }
  if(form){
    form.addEventListener('submit', function(e){
      e.preventDefault();
      if(!validate()) return;
      if(FORM_ENDPOINT){
        var btn=document.getElementById('modalSubmit'); var label=btn.textContent; btn.textContent='Sending\u2026';
        fetch(FORM_ENDPOINT,{method:'POST',body:new FormData(form),headers:{'Accept':'application/json'}})
          .then(function(){goSuccess();})
          .catch(function(){goSuccess();})
          .then(function(){btn.textContent=label;});
      } else {
        goSuccess();
      }
    });
  }
  if(overlay){
    overlay.addEventListener('click', function(e){ if(e.target===overlay){closeModal();} });
  }
  document.addEventListener('keydown', function(e){
    if(e.key==='Escape' && overlay && overlay.classList.contains('open')){closeModal();}
  });
  document.addEventListener('click', function(e){
    var closer=e.target.closest ? e.target.closest('[data-close]') : null;
    if(closer){ e.preventDefault(); closeModal(); return; }
    var mod=e.target.closest ? e.target.closest('[data-modal]') : null;
    if(mod){ e.preventDefault(); closeDrawer(); openModal(mod.getAttribute('data-modal')); return; }
    var t=e.target.closest ? e.target.closest('[data-nav]') : null;
    if(!t) return;
    e.preventDefault();
    closeDrawer();
    var page=t.getAttribute('data-nav');
    if(page==='software'){
      show('home');
      var s=document.getElementById('software');
      if(s){s.scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth'});}
      return;
    }
    show(page);
    window.scrollTo({top:0,behavior:'smooth'});
  });
  show('home');
})();
</script>

</body>
</html>
